d: Speaking on 'Strategic Culture of India and National Security' at SCNSS, JNU on November 3, former CDS General Anil Chauhan (Retd.) said, "Strategic culture is a sum total of values and habits that guide a society; when I say a society, that's a larger thing; it's a nation that takes actions intuitively for self-preservation, self-promotion, and even self-aggrandisement. It's the ability of a society to face forceful danger, avoid it without compromising national interests, and, if presented with an unavoidable choice, employ all instruments of national power to defend those interests..."
